subject: Draft Medford Comprehensive Plan
overview: The Committee of the Whole met with city planning staff and consultants to review the draft Medford Comprehensive Plan. The council discussed density, housing affordability, displacement, municipal capacity, and funding strategies, keeping the paper in committee.

items.title: Draft Medford Comprehensive Plan (Paper 22-496)
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt and consultants presented the draft Medford Comprehensive Plan's five core themes, followed by council discussion on density, commercial development, displacement mitigation, municipal staffing capacity, and capital funding needs. The paper was kept in committee.
